verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a desktop chat and model-management app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents exporting chats, prompts, configurations or other user data in open formats, or any migration path out. The closest items, on managing local models, prompts and configurations, and on folders for organizing chats, are adjacent features rather than export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
